overview_description.description: Understudy Labs provides software tools that help teams optimize repeated large language model workflows. The platform captures production traces and expert feedback, turns them into evaluations and reward signals, and then tunes prompts, schemas, routing, and model choices. Understudy supports supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to produce specialist open models and routes that match task-specific quality targets. Its gateway and local tools integrate with existing coding agents and LLM providers so engineers can start locally and scale to cloud-based training. The resulting prompts, evaluators, routing rules, and model weights are designed to be owned and served by the customer.
